name: e2e-gated

Decide.prompt: Flip a mental coin. Output exactly one word — either YES or NO — in all caps. No other text.

Say_Yes.prompt: The coin came up YES. Say one short celebratory sentence. No preamble.

Say_No.prompt: The coin came up NO. Say one short resigned sentence. No preamble.

graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Decide
    state Decide_Route <<choice>>
    Decide --> Decide_Route
    Decide_Route --> Say_Yes: yes
    Decide_Route --> Say_No: no
    Say_Yes --> [*]
    Say_No --> [*]
